# Data Processing Terms (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE)

Last updated: 2026-09-01

## Use of customer data
We process customer data only to provide the service. We may use customer data, including content you submit, to develop and improve our products, including training our machine learning models.

## Retention
Customer data is retained for up to 24 months of account termination.

## Sub-processors
We notify customers at least 30 days before adding a new sub-processor.
